snippet.title: Playtest Announcement: Monster Mercs
snippet.description:
The Monster Mercs Alpha Playtest is officially coming!

Monster Mercs is a 1–4 player co-op fantasy action RPG where you take on dangerous contracts, fight through monster-infested missions, collect loot, and transform into the monsters you defeat.

This playtest is the next chapter in our development story. Player feedback has already shaped major parts of Monster Mercs, and this Alpha Playtest is our chance to get the game into more hands, learn what’s working, and keep building the game with the community.

Request access to the Playtest on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4234330/Monster_Mercs/

Join the Discord and help shape development:
https://discord.gg/WCZjMtdyY

Follow development:
https://x.com/izakgamesstudio
https://www.youtube.com/@UCgLLBG0FUnnBkNEvsG9EZUQ 
https://www.tiktok.com/@UCgLLBG0FUnnBkNEvsG9EZUQ 

About Monster Mercs:
When the kingdom needs its dirty work done, they don’t call heroes. They hire mercenaries. Take on contracts, extract with loot, unlock powerful monster transformations, and survive long enough to get paid.

#MonsterMercs #IndieGame #CoopGame #ActionRPG #SteamPlaytest #IndieDev
